01 / The property

A promising blank canvas in Hazeldean.

An open-plan bachelor apartment with its own patio access, compact kitchen, bathroom and built-in storage. Its existing layout lends itself to a considered, space-efficient furnishing concept.

Located in Oukraal Estate, with access to a swimming pool, clubhouse and braai facilities, subject to estate rules. The listing notes proximity to Curro High School, shopping and public transport.

02 / Existing condition

The apartment, as it stands.

Real listing photographs provide the starting point. The fixed layout, doors, windows and plumbing will guide all design decisions.

03 / Proposed transformation

Modern hotel-suite living.

Our design direction: soft warm-white or pale-grey walls, refined charcoal upholstery, glossy white cabinet fronts where replacement is approved, layered textiles, warm lighting and a clean, high-end hotel aesthetic.

Design visualisation only. These are owner-selected proposed renovation visualisations inspired by the supplied apartment photographs, not photographs of completed work or dimensionally exact edits of the original rooms. Actual furniture placement, repainting, cabinet upgrades and curtain installation depend on measurements, permissions and an approved scope.

Sleep beautifully

Double bed with hotel-quality white linen, charcoal or grey upholstered headboard, compact bedside lighting and blackout-ready window treatment.

Live comfortably

Compact charcoal sofa or lounge chair, slim TV solution, soft rug, small table and tasteful wall art, without crowding circulation.

Arrive and unwind

Full-length curtains at the patio-facing doors, layered sheers and blackout drapes, plus two elegant compact outdoor chairs and a small table where permitted.

04 / Five styling zones

Every corner considered.

ILLUSTRATIVE STYLING MOODBOARD
01 — Bedroom & living areaHotel-style bed, layered linen, charcoal sofa, compact rug, television, warm ambient lighting.

05 / Furnishing checklist

Everything a guest needs. Nothing unnecessary.

A practical procurement checklist for a two-guest bachelor suite. No furniture prices are included; final quantities and specifications follow the site measurements.

Sleeping & living

Double bed and mattress · Mattress protector · 2–3 linen sets · Pillows and protectors · Duvet · Throw · Bedside tables · Lamps · Compact charcoal sofa or armchairs · Rug · Coffee/side table · Smart TV · TV mount or slim stand · Full-length mirror · Hangers · Curtains and tracks.

Kitchen & dining

Fridge/freezer · Microwave · Kettle · Toaster · Basic cookware · Frying pan and saucepan · Ovenware · Plates and bowls · Cutlery · Glasses and mugs · Cooking utensils · Chopping board · Knife set · Dish rack · Bin · Cleaning equipment · Compact two-person dining/work table and chairs, space permitting.

Bath, patio & operations

Bath towels and hand towels · Bathmat · Soap dispensers · Toilet brush · Bathroom bin · Hairdryer · First-aid kit · Fire-safety equipment as required · Wi-Fi · Guest guide · Spare bulbs and batteries · Iron and ironing board · Patio chairs and table, if allowed · Lockable owner storage where feasible.

A fridge, microwave, TV, internet, safe guest access and suitable cleaning arrangements should be confirmed during the walkthrough. The existing photographs do not establish that these items are already present.
06 / Guest proposition

Designed for a better stay, not just a better photograph.

Potential audiences include visiting professionals, couples, people seeing family nearby and guests attending local appointments. These are target segments to test through comparable listings—not proven bookings for this property.

Comfort

Reliable Wi-Fi, quality sleep, practical cooking facilities and a calm interior.

Convenience

Ground-floor access, parking subject to confirmation and a well-organised check-in experience.

Care

Consistent housekeeping, clear communication and responsive maintenance coordination.

08 / Our management partnership

One management partner. Every stay considered.

25%

Proposed Luxenest management fee on the agreed accommodation-revenue basis, as defined in the signed management agreement.

For example, if the applicable accommodation revenue is R12,000, the 25% management fee is R3,000, leaving R9,000 before other operating expenses and operating expenses.

Cleaning and laundry, consumables, utilities, repairs, platform charges, furnishings, taxes and other expenses are separate unless expressly included in writing. The agreement will specify the fee basis and treatment of cancellations, refunds and platform deductions.

10 / Important considerations

Feasibility before commitment.

Can the apartment legally operate as an Airbnb?

Not yet confirmed. Check Oukraal Estate rules, any body corporate restrictions, local requirements and local short-stay requirements.

Are the market figures verified?

The proposal includes a dated Pretoria studio dataset and one Hazeldean advertised comparator. Oukraal-specific performance has not been verified.

Is painting or replacing kitchen cupboard fronts included?

These are optional proposed improvements and require written approval, a measured scope and separate quotations. The design concepts should not be interpreted as work already carried out.

What is included in the 25%?

Management and coordination services described above. Furnishing and third-party operating costs are separate unless agreed otherwise in the contract.

Who owns the furniture?

Ownership, purchasing authority, procurement fees, warranties and removal rights will be set out in the furnishing agreement before procurement.
